addr: 1st Floor, RMZ ECOWORLD, Mall, Adarsh Palm Retreat Villas, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

rev.t: Interesting book store that I can easily find interesting books to buy. Will come again!

The store itself is good but the staff was not very helpful. I was looking for gifts for 3yr old and she just pointed to the section with kids books, no guidance at all. It was not even crowded, and she was sitting idle behind the counter. …

Great place. Bought a couple of books. Would like to visit again 🫶
But please fix the ACs. Too Hot!!! …
